title: Visa Intelligent Commerce — product overview
quote: a platform enabling AI agents to conduct secure, seamless transactions on behalf of consumers and businesses... 4.8 billion payment credentials, 150+ million merchant locations, 300+ billion transactions annually.

title: Visa Intelligent Commerce — developer overview
quote: four integrated services: Tokenization, Authentication (Passkey), Payment Instructions, and Signals... A new pass-through payment token, specific to agents... tokenized credentials that are bound to that agent and can only be used in context of the agent making purchases on user's behalf.

title: Visa Trusted Agent Protocol — overview
quote: Three Signal Elements: Agent Intent, Consumer Recognition, Payment Information. Cryptographic signatures that are merchant-specific, purpose-bound, and time-limited.

title: Visa Trusted Agent Protocol — specifications
quote: Signature-Input and Signature headers. Ed25519 for agent recognition signature; PS256 for consumer and payment container objects. JWKS at https://mcp.visa.com/.well-known/jwks. Signature covers @authority and @path; 8-minute created/expires window; nonce blocks replay.

title: visa/trusted-agent-protocol GitHub repo
quote: Establishing a universal standard of trust between AI agents and merchants for the next phase of agentic commerce.

title: visa/mcp — Integration toolkit for Visa Intelligent Commerce via MCP
quote: @visa/token-manager (JWE), @visa/mcp-client, @visa/api-client (X-Pay authentication and Message Level Encryption). Documentation MCP Server endpoint https://sandbox.mcp.visa.com/mcp/doc. vic-agent demo: VTS card tokenization, FIDO device binding, Visa Payment Passkey creation, VIC enrollment.

title: Visa Intelligent Commerce Connect — product page
quote: agnostic agentic commerce across networks, payment schemes, commerce platforms and agents... single integration point across multiple networks and agents... AI-ready product catalogs by normalizing existing data.

title: Visa Opens the Door to AI-Driven Shopping for Businesses Worldwide
quote: Intelligent Commerce Connect... single integration via the Visa Acceptance Platform... merchants to accept payments initiated via major agent protocols including Trusted Agent Protocol, Machine Payments Protocol (MPP), Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP), and Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP). Pilot partners: Aldar, AWS, Diddo, Highnote, Mesh, Payabli, Sumvin.

title: Visa and Partners Complete Secure AI Transactions
quote: hundreds of controlled, real-world agent-initiated transactions; pilot participants Skyfire, Nekuda, PayOS, Ramp; over 100 global partners; expansion in Asia Pacific and Europe in early 2026; mainstream adoption targeted for 2026 holiday season.

title: Visa Introduces Trusted Agent Protocol
quote: open specification that signs an AI agent's identity into HTTP request headers... available today in the Visa Developer Center and GitHub.

title: Visa Announces Global Expansion of Agentic Ready Program
quote: April 29, 2026: expansion to Asia Pacific and Latin America; 85+ additional partners; test agent-initiated payments in controlled, real-world environments using live cards and real merchants.

title: Introducing Visa Intelligent Commerce on AWS
quote: AgentCore Runtime: secure, serverless hosting environment... isolated micro VM sandboxes; Identity; Gateway; Memory; Observability built on OpenTelemetry. Before transaction execution, agents request explicit human confirmation via request_purchase_confirmation, then trigger payment through confirm_purchase.

quote: TAP focuses on verifying the actor's legitimacy, while competitors reimagine payment initiation interfaces... cryptographic protocols alone are insufficient — they require complementary fraud detection.
